text.style: font-weight: 700; font-size: 11px; font-family: 'Arial', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #302a39

g.text: Figure 2 | Distinguishing opinion change, convergence and factual improvement.

text.style: font-size: 8.3px; font-family: 'Arial', sans-serif; fill: #514b58

g.text: a, Three constructed examples show round-two and round-three rating distributions for 20 hypothetical participants per example. Lines join discrete

text.style: font-size: 8.3px; font-family: 'Arial', sans-serif; fill: #514b58

g.text: proportions and are not continuous belief densities. These examples illustrate possible patterns; they were not selected from the consultations in b–c. b,

text.style: font-size: 8.3px; font-family: 'Arial', sans-serif; fill: #514b58

g.text: Each fine line connects the same simulated consultation in rounds two and three; descending lines indicate reduced disagreement. Bold lines and labelled

text.style: font-size: 8.3px; font-family: 'Arial', sans-serif; fill: #514b58

g.text: endpoints show arithmetic means, not uncertainty intervals. Feedback and no-feedback panels share identical scales. These are consultation-level

text.style: font-size: 8.3px; font-family: 'Arial', sans-serif; fill: #514b58

g.text: trajectories, not individual participant ratings. Scores are reused from the existing illustrative deliberation dataset (100 cases per arm); they were

text.style: font-size: 8.3px; font-family: 'Arial', sans-serif; fill: #514b58

g.text: constructed directly, not calculated from recorded ballots. c, The same simulated feedback cases show changes in disagreement and factual accuracy.

text.style: font-size: 8.3px; font-family: 'Arial', sans-serif; fill: #514b58

g.text: Convergence can accompany improvement or worsening; accuracy is meaningful only for questions with assessable answers. Contours in c enclose 50% and 90% of

text.style: font-size: 8.3px; font-family: 'Arial', sans-serif; fill: #514b58

g.text: each estimated density and are descriptive, not confidence intervals. For a real experiment, randomise consultations to feedback or no feedback, retain

text.style: font-size: 8.3px; font-family: 'Arial', sans-serif; fill: #514b58

g.text: identical claims and scales, prespecify the disagreement measure, and compare matched participants while reporting attrition. These simulations demonstrate

text.style: font-size: 8.3px; font-family: 'Arial', sans-serif; fill: #514b58

g.text: the figure design and do not establish a causal feedback effect.
